messages:
owen: Quick heads-up — the runtime sprint finished and we pushed the prefetch + small-batcher tweaks to a 5% canary for the production mix. Early numbers look great. :tada:
kevin: Ran the canary against the 3-day traffic sample. Summary: p50 -12%, p95 -15%, p99 -18%. Token compute cost ~11% lower vs baseline. Saw the biggest wins on short-chat workloads (seq <= 64).
runtime-bot: Canary summary uploaded: https://internal.redwood/bench/canary/2456789012. Key metrics (avg across shards):
```
- baseline p50 24ms -> canary p50 21ms
- baseline p95 112ms -> canary p95 95ms
- baseline p99 332ms -> canary p99 272ms
- cost per 1k tokens: $0.072 -> $0.064
- error rate: 0.12% -> 0.11%
```
julia: Nice. What are the rollback triggers if we see regressions? Need thresholds for latency spike, error uplift, and memory growth.
amanda: This is awesome for the product metrics sprint. Any changes we should announce to customers (e.g., latency improvements for multi-turn chat)?
kevin: Rollback triggers we set in the canary job: latency p99 increase > 8% OR error rate increase > 0.5% OR sustained CUDA memory growth > 50MB for 10m. Config snippet: 
```
canary:
  pct: 5
  ramp: 5 -> 50 -> 100 over 3h
  rollback_triggers:
    p99_pct_increase: 8
    error_rate_abs_increase: 0.5
    cuda_mem_mb_growth: 50
```
owen: Monitoring hooks added to console dashboards (per-route p50/p95/p99 + unit cost). If the canary stays healthy we'll ramp to 50% in 2h, then 100% later today.
julia: Make sure the alerting playbook has the new metric names (runtime.prefix.prefetch.*). I'll watch the PagerDuty for the next 4h.
kevin: One subtlety: we added a microcache TTL bump for short prefixes which improved batching hit-rate by ~9%. That plus the small-batcher change reduced fragmentation on the coalescer.
amanda: Can we get a short blurb for the weekly product update? 1-2 lines + numbers would be perfect.
owen: Draft for weekly: "Runtime improvements (prefetch + small-batcher) reduced median latency by 12% and p99 by 18% for common chat workloads; estimated token cost down 11%. Rolling to all traffic today."
julia: :eyes: I'll keep a close watch but so far the canary graphs look stable.
kevin: I'll open a follow-up PR with a heatmap of sequence-length vs p99 and a note about the fallback policy we used during the canary.
owen: Thanks team — great sprint. If no regressions by 15:00 UTC we flip the final switch. :rocket:
